title: Common questions
html:
Who sold me the product?

Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC operates Fernwork. The billing descriptor for store purchases is FERN WORK. If your order number and statement amount do not match, send the amount and date to PumpCadle668@outlook.com.

Does the delivery estimate include packing?

The Shipping and delivery page lists the time we need to prepare the order, the carrier's transit time and the total estimate.

Can I change my order or return one item?

Contact PumpCadle668@outlook.com as soon as possible for a change. For a partial return, tell us which item and quantity. Returns, refunds and order cancellations gives the deadline, costs and refund calculation.

My refund is approved. Why is it missing from my statement?

Ask us whether the refund has been issued; we can give its amount, date and any reference for your bank. A pending authorisation on a cancelled order may disappear without a separate refund entry.

Will I be charged again after buying a product?

Not unless you buy again. Nothing on this store renews automatically.

How do I reach a person?

Email PumpCadle668@outlook.com or call (269) 240-6135 during Weekday evenings, Eastern Time. Usual first response is within one business day.
